record.dic_text:
3400 milion {mil'-ee-on}

源自拉丁文; 中性名詞

欽定本 - mile 1; 1

1) 一里, 古羅馬人長度的單位, 等於千步, 約1.5 公里 [少於一英里] (#太 5:41|)
record.edic_text:
3400 milion {mil'-ee-on}

of Latin origin;; n n

AV - mile 1; 1

1) a mile, among the Romans the distance of a thousand paces or
   eight stadia, about 1.5 km [somewhat less than our mile]
